We excel at delivering innovative, operationally ready, and cost-effective IT solutions that accelerate the interoperability and resiliency of mission-critical systems. What will you be doing? World Wide Technology (WWT) is seeking a Systems Engineer to lead the technical deployment, integration, performance optimization, and lifecycle sustainment of enterprise cybersecurity platforms within secure Department of Defense (DoD) environments. In this position, you will act as a pivotal systems integrator bridging bare-metal hardware, operating systems, virtualization layers, container platforms, network forensics, and high-throughput data telemetry pipelines. You will design and administer robust, resilient operating platforms, maintain high availability across distributed clusters, implement infrastructure automation, and ensure seamless system interoperability between advanced cyber defense tools and multi-tenant mission architectures. Containerization & Virtualization Orchestration: Deploy, configure, scale, and maintain containerized workloads (Docker) and virtual machines (VMware ESXi, KVM, and cloud environments), ensuring multi-tenant resource isolation, resilience, and automated recovery. Linux Administration & Hardening: Administer and troubleshoot enterprise Linux operating systems across diverse distributions (e.g., Red Hat Enterprise Linux, Rocky Linux, Ubuntu). Automation & Scripting: Develop, test, and maintain robust Python and Bash automation scripts to orchestrate system configurations, streamline health diagnostics, automate platform patching, and execute repetitive operational workflows. Network Forensics & Sensor Infrastructure: Integrate, configure, tune, and sustain network traffic capture and packet inspection engines (such as Zeek, Suricata, and network taps/aggregators) across high-throughput mission network segments. Data Pipelines & Telemetry Management: Support large-scale telemetry ingestion, index management, and cluster health for data search platforms such as the Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), ensuring uninterrupted data flow from distributed endpoints and network sensors. Cloud & API Systems Integration: Manage system-level API integrations across secure cloud components and third-party cyber tooling; build connectors and data routing scripts to ensure reliable telemetry delivery to analytic engines. Performance Monitoring & Capacity Planning: Continuously monitor platform resource utilization, memory/CPU bottlenecks, I/O performance, and network throughput; formulate proactive capacity scaling recommendations. Cross-Functional Systems Collaboration: Collaborate closely with cyber defense operators, SOC analysts, and engineering teams to translate threat detection workflows and ATT&CK-aligned requirements into high-performing, resilient platform specifications. Technical Documentation & Accreditation: Author and update comprehensive systems architecture blueprints, standard operating procedures (SOPs), data-flow diagrams, and technical artifacts required for DoD Authority to Operate (ATO) packages and lifecycle sustainment. , Required Qualifications Security Clearance: Active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility required. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related engineering field. Professional Experience: Minimum of 4+ years of hands-on experience in systems engineering, platform infrastructure operations, or enterprise systems administration supporting Department of Defense (DoD), intelligence, or federal mission environments. Infrastructure & Hardware Engineering: Proven experience configuring, cabling, deploying, and maintaining enterprise server hardware, storage devices, and networking equipment (switches, routers, firewalls, and VLAN configurations). Operating Systems: Demonstrated proficiency in administering, configuring, and troubleshooting enterprise Linux distributions (RHEL, Rocky, CentOS, Ubuntu). Virtualization & Containers: Demonstrated hands-on experience deploying, managing, and maintaining containerized environments (Docker) and hypervisor platforms (VMware ESXi, KVM, or cloud equivalents). Automation & Scripting: Practical ability to write and maintain automation scripts using Python and shell/Bash to interface with REST APIs and manage infrastructure tasks. Data & Log Aggregation Platforms: Experience supporting large-scale log aggregation, distributed search clusters, or enterprise telemetry tools (e.g., Elastic Stack [ELK], MDE, Trellix, Tanium). Compliance Certification: Active DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II certification (e.g., CompTIA Security+, CySA+, CCNA Security, or equivalent). Preferred Experience Sensor & Network Tooling: Direct hands-on experience maintaining network traffic inspection tools (Zeek, Suricata) and telemetry collection pipelines. Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Familiarity with configuration management tools (Ansible, Puppet, Terraform) within secure, air-gapped, or disconnected environments. Security Frameworks & STIGs: Experience implementing DISA STIGs, SCAP compliance scans, and supporting Risk Management Framework (RMF) accreditation lifecycles. Detection & Threat Intelligence Alignment: Familiarity with threat intelligence models, attack correlation concepts, and the MITRE ATT&CK framework as applied to platform data ingestion. Want to learn more about Government Services? Check us out on our platform: https://www.wwt.com/public-sector https://www.wwt.com/government-services Preferred locations: Certain states and localities require employers to post a reasonable estimate of salary range. Actual salary will be based on a variety of factors, including shift, location, experience, skill set, performance, licensure and certification, and business needs. The range for this position in other geographic locations may differ. Certain positions may also be eligible for variable incentive compensation, such as bonuses or commissions, that is not included in the base pay. The well-being of WWT employees is essential. Our goal is to cultivate a culture of belonging that encourages innovation, collaboration, and respect for all team members, ensuring that WWT remains a great place to work for All! Liderar esfuerzos de modernización enfocados en consolidación de plataformas, estandarización, resiliencia, excelencia operativa y optimización de costos. Proporcionar gobernanza y supervisión arquitectónica para infraestructura, nube, seguridad y plataformas de aplicaciones empresariales. Ingeniería de Plataformas y Automatización Establecer y liderar prácticas de Ingeniería de Plataformas que permitan el autoservicio, la estandarización y una entrega acelerada de servicios. Impulsar la adopción de Infraestructura como Código (IaC) utilizando tecnologías como Terraform, Bicep, Azure DevOps y flujos de trabajo basados en Git. Desarrollar estrategias de automatización para eliminar tareas operativas repetitivas, aumentar la confiabilidad de los servicios y mejorar la eficiencia operativa. Promover la excelencia en ingeniería mediante servicios reutilizables de plataforma, marcos de automatización y prácticas DevOps. Ingeniería de Confiabilidad de Sitios (SRE) Liderar la adopción de los principios de Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) en los equipos de infraestructura y plataformas. Establecer y gobernar Indicadores de Nivel de Servicio (SLIs), Objetivos de Nivel de Servicio (SLOs) y Presupuestos de Error para servicios críticos del negocio. Impulsar mejoras en disponibilidad, resiliencia, rendimiento y madurez operativa de los servicios. Liderar iniciativas para reducir el Tiempo Medio de Detección (MTTD), el Tiempo Medio de Resolución (MTTR) y la recurrencia de incidentes operativos. Desarrollar prácticas proactivas de confiabilidad, incluyendo planificación de capacidad, ingeniería de rendimiento y pruebas de resiliencia. Observabilidad e Inteligencia Operativa Definir e implementar estrategias empresariales de observabilidad que abarquen infraestructura, aplicaciones, plataformas cloud, bases de datos y servicios de negocio. Gobernar plataformas y herramientas de monitoreo, incluyendo APM, monitoreo de infraestructura, monitoreo sintético, análisis de logs y soluciones de gestión de eventos. Establecer visibilidad de extremo a extremo mediante tableros, telemetría, estándares de alertas y monitoreo de servicios de negocio. Impulsar la mejora continua en correlación de eventos, reducción de ruido de alertas, análisis de causa raíz y analítica operativa. Garantizar que las capacidades de observabilidad respalden la gestión de incidentes, problemas y objetivos de continuidad del negocio. Gestión de Proveedores y Gobernanza de Servicios Gestionar proveedores estratégicos de tecnología, proveedores de servicios administrados y socios de software. Liderar negociaciones contractuales, revisiones de desempeño de proveedores, gobernanza de SLA e iniciativas de mejora de servicios. Garantizar que los proveedores cumplan con las obligaciones contractuales, compromisos de servicio, requisitos de seguridad y expectativas del negocio. Gestionar presupuestos tecnológicos, licenciamiento de software, renovaciones de proveedores y oportunidades de optimización de costos. Gestión de Plataforma Windows Proporcionar liderazgo arquitectónico y gobernanza para entornos empresariales de Windows Server. Supervisar Active Directory, Políticas de Grupo (GPO), DNS, DHCP, gestión de parches, endurecimiento de seguridad y prácticas de seguridad operativa. Garantizar alta disponibilidad, escalabilidad y gestión del ciclo de vida de los servicios de infraestructura Windows. Liderar iniciativas de modernización para entornos Windows híbridos e integrados con la nube. Gestión de SQL Server Gobernar entornos empresariales de SQL Server, garantizando rendimiento, disponibilidad, seguridad y escalabilidad. Establecer estándares para arquitectura de bases de datos, respaldos y recuperación, recuperación ante desastres y gestión de capacidad. Impulsar iniciativas de modernización, optimización y automatización de bases de datos. Garantizar que los servicios de bases de datos soporten aplicaciones críticas para el negocio y los compromisos de nivel de servicio. Gestión de Identidades y Accesos (IAM) Definir y gobernar la estrategia empresarial de IAM, su arquitectura y procesos operativos. Liderar iniciativas relacionadas con Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Single Sign-On (SSO), Autenticación Multifactor (MFA), Acceso Condicional, PAM y PIM. Garantizar que los servicios de identidad estén alineados con los principios de Zero Trust y los requisitos regulatorios. Supervisar la gobernanza de identidades, los controles de acceso privilegiado, la preparación para auditorías y los objetivos de cumplimiento. Gestión de SAP Basis Proporcionar supervisión y gobernanza de entornos SAP Basis, incluyendo ECC, S/4HANA, BW y plataformas relacionadas. Liderar la arquitectura de plataformas SAP, actualizaciones, aplicación de parches, optimización de rendimiento, alta disponibilidad e iniciativas de recuperación ante desastres. Garantizar la integración de la infraestructura SAP con bases de datos, plataformas cloud, servicios de seguridad y soluciones de observabilidad. Impulsar la mejora continua de la estabilidad operativa y el rendimiento de las plataformas SAP. Seguridad, Riesgo y Cumplimiento Garantizar que los servicios de infraestructura y plataforma cumplan con las políticas de seguridad, requisitos regulatorios y controles de auditoría. Colaborar con los equipos de ciberseguridad para implementar estándares de arquitectura segura y marcos de gobernanza. Apoyar programas de cumplimiento como SOX, ISO 27001, NIST y requisitos de auditoría interna. Liderar evaluaciones de riesgo, planes de mitigación y estrategias de continuidad operativa. Liderazgo de Equipos y Desarrollo de Talento Liderar y desarrollar equipos multidisciplinarios responsables de arquitectura, ingeniería, operaciones y entrega de servicios. Fomentar una cultura de innovación, automatización, responsabilidad y mejora continua. Proporcionar liderazgo técnico, mentoría, planificación de sucesión y desarrollo profesional. Fortalecer capacidades organizacionales en cloud, SRE, observabilidad, automatización, ingeniería de plataformas y tecnologías emergentes. Relacionamiento Ejecutivo y del Negocio Actuar como asesor estratégico de confianza para líderes de negocio, ejecutivos de tecnología y stakeholders clave. Traducir conceptos técnicos complejos en resultados de negocio y recomendaciones estratégicas. Presentar estrategias de arquitectura, métricas de desempeño operativo, hojas de ruta de inversión y planes de transformación al liderazgo ejecutivo. Impulsar la alineación transversal entre infraestructura, aplicaciones, seguridad, operaciones y equipos de negocio.

review_candidates.title: Senior Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: About Peraton Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure. About The Role Position Overview We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Network Engineer to support a federal government customer in designing, implementing, securing, and maintaining enterprise network infrastructure within a mission-critical environment. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Cisco networking technologies, network security, enterprise routing and switching, and secure government networking standards. This role requires strong technical leadership, hands-on engineering capabilities, and the ability to operate in secure and dynamic operational environments. Key Responsibilities Design, implement, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure. Plan and deploy standardized configurations across enterprise switching environments. Lead migration efforts from End-of-Life (EOL) devices. Design, deploy, and manage solutions for network access control and authentication services. Implement and maintain DISA STIG hardening guidelines and security compliance standards across network infrastructure. Support deployment and integration of encryption devices and manage cryptographic equipment imports. Assist with fiber optic cabling installations, infrastructure upgrades, and connectivity troubleshooting. Design and implement IP subnetting strategies and IP address management solutions. Monitor and respond to incidents through internal ticketing systems while providing Tier III network support. Travel to remote locations to deploy network infrastructure and extend enterprise services. Troubleshoot and resolve complex networking issues involving: Routing protocols (OSPF, BGP) Layer 2 switching VOIP systems Layer 1 cabling and physical connectivity IPSec tunnels and Type-1 cryptographic equipment Utilize SolarWinds and other network monitoring tools to proactively monitor network performance and generate operational reports. Configure and maintain environmental monitoring systems and sensors within data centers and server rooms. Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), technical documentation, and operational runbooks. Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and cross-training to junior network engineers and support personnel. Collaborate with cybersecurity, systems engineering, and facilities teams to ensure reliable and secure network operations. Qualifications Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience). Minimum of 16 years experience 8+ years of experience supporting enterprise network infrastructure in complex environments. Experience implementing DISA STIGs and secure network configurations in federal environments. Knowledge of enterprise network security principles and best practices. Experience supporting VOIP technologies and troubleshooting telecommunications issues. Ability to read and understand network diagrams, technical documentation, and infrastructure schematics. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Active TS/SCI or Q/SCI clearance. US Citizen. Preferred Qualifications Cisco certifications such as CCNP Enterprise or CCIE. Experience supporting Department of Energy (DOE) or other federal government agencies. Knowledge of network automation and scripting tools. Prior experience working in classified or secure operational environments. Details Target Salary Range: $135,000 - $216,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits. Application Statements: The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own. EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

review_candidates.description: Zachary Piper Solutions is seeking a NOC Lead to support a federal program with the Department of Energy (DOE) and National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA) in Manassas, VA . The NOC Lead will oversee 24x7x365 Network Operations Center operations, ensuring the availability, performance, security, and operational integrity of enterprise infrastructure and services. Responsibilities of the NOC Lead include: Lead 24x7x365 NOC operations, ensuring continuous monitoring, availability, and performance of enterprise infrastructure. Manage major incidents, escalations, outage response, and service restoration efforts while meeting SLA requirements. Oversee network performance optimization, operational readiness, change implementation, and risk mitigation activities. Supervise and mentor NOC analysts and engineers, ensuring adherence to SOPs, effective shift handoffs, and workload management. Coordinate with stakeholders, vendors, and technical teams while providing operational reporting, metrics, and service communications. Qualifications for the NOC Lead include: Active Top Secret clearance with investigation completed within the last 5 years. 5-10 years of experience in IT Operations, Network Operations, Systems Administration, or related technical environments. 2-5 years of experience leading technical teams within a 24x7x365 NOC or operational environment. Experience managing incidents, outages, escalations, service restoration activities, and SLA-driven operations. Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, firewalls, Cisco IOS-XE, Cisco NX-OS, Arista EOS, Spine/Leaf architecture, and WAN technologies. Experience supporting Windows and Linux environments and utilizing tools such as Splunk, Ansible, Tenable, GEMS, Riverbed NetIM, Wireshark, and PAN-OS. Familiarity with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud platforms. Compensation for the NOC Lead includes: Salary: $190,000 Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), PTO, Sick Leave if required by law, and Paid Holidays This job opens for applications on September 20, 2026. Applications for this job will be accepted for at least 30 days from the posting date.
